title: NBN Lonsdale POI (SA) – planned maintenance
current_summary: Planned maintenance at the NBN Lonsdale POI (SA) may interrupt some NBN services for up to 7 hours during the window. Scheduled for 11:00 pm Tue 6 Oct to 6:00 am Wed 7 Oct 2026 (ACDT).

updates.content: Scheduled maintenance: A network provider will relocate and cut over cabling at the NBN Lonsdale POI (SA). Some NBN services served by this POI may experience interruptions for up to 7 hours during the window. Timing: 11:00 pm Tue 6 Oct to 6:00 am Wed 7 Oct 2026 (ACDT). We will provide updates if the schedule changes.
